entities.summary: Talorcan son of Uurguist was a king of the Picts. The Annals of Ulster report the death of Dub Tholargg king of the Picts on this side of the Mounth in 782. He is presumed to have been the son of Óengus mac Fergusa. He was succeeded by his son Drest.
